blocks.text: Nail you times with every lap with the support of the Sport Ironman® Black and Purple Mid Size 10 Lap watch from Timex®.Features Indiglo® night-light with convenient Night-Mode selection for easy viewing in low-light conditions.Resin wristband with all the classic Ironman® detailing.Night-Mode® feature.100-hour chronograph with lap or split option, either in large digits.99 lap counter.Built-in setting reminders.Forward/backward setting.24-hour countdown timer with: countdown/stop (CS) and countdown/repeat (CR).Top pusher for easy lap and split option.10-lap memory recall.Alarm settable for daily/weekday/weekend and weekly with 5-minute backup.Water-resistant to depths of 100m.Reverse digital display or all-day white reflector display.Measurements:  Case Height: 31 mm Case Width: 35 mm Case Depth: 10 mm Band Width: 9 1⁄2 mm Band Circumference/Length: 9 in Weight: 1 oz

items.label: Performance Function
items.value: 100-hour chronograph with 10-lap memory and 24-hour countdown timer built for everyday training and timing precision

items.label: Everyday Utility
items.value: Customizable alarm, 24-hour military time mode, dual time zones, and full day/date/month calendar keep you on schedule

items.label: Clear Readability
items.value: Gray digital display with INDIGLO light-up dial ensures visibility in any light

items.label: Durable Build
items.value: 34 mm black and purple resin case with acrylic lens offers lasting protection and sporty appeal

items.label: Comfort Fit
items.value: Adjustable black 12 mm resin strap fits wrists up to 7.5 inches

items.label: Additional Features
items.value: Chronograph, Timer, Alarm, Second Time Zone, Day, Date, Month, Light Up, Water Resistant, Calculator, Stopwatch, Lightweight
